title: Plant diary sheet
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Skeletons, muscles, nutrition and plants (Tribal Tales)
source: Seeded from science/y3 lesson 21 (Plant diary sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 21: Setting up the cress test and plant diary. To understand how to set up a fair test and record observations over time

questions.q: Pot 3 has light but no water. What does it test?
questions.model: Compare pot 3 with pot 1. The only difference is water. So pot 3 tests water.

questions.q: Why give each pot the same number of spoons of water?
How will you measure the cress?
questions.a: With a ruler, in millimetres, from the base to the top

questions.q: Set up your four pots with an adult, label them and fill in day 1 of the diary.
questions.a: Four labelled pots; day 1 row filled ('seeds', no growth)
questions.model: Teacher sets up pot 1 on camera: cotton wool, 20 seeds, 2 spoons of water, label, windowsill.

questions.q: Write which pot you think will grow tallest and why.
questions.a: Pot 1, because it has light, water and warmth

questions.q: What could go wrong in this test, and how could we stop it?
questions.a: For example: a pot might be knocked over or get extra water; label clearly and keep a watering chart.

questions.q: Seeds starting to grow is called...
Big question: how will we know if our prediction was right?
questions.a: By measuring and recording each pot in the diary and comparing them.
